subject: general
question: An object is stationary then the force is still acting on it is:
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 1**__ i.e **Weight.**

__
 
• An object is stationary then the force is still acting on it is **Weight.**__
 
• 
 Weight is just another word for the force of gravity Fg.
 
 
• 
 Weight is a force that acts at all times on all objects near Earth.
 
 
• 
 **Momentum:** It is defined as the quantity of motion of the body.
 
 
• 
 **Acceleration** is the rate of change of velocity.
